crossRefs.note: Then the king sent a captain of fifty with his fifty to him. He went up to him; and behold, he was sitting on the top…
When evildoers came at me to eat up my flesh, even my adversaries and my foes, they stumbled and fell.
Let them be disappointed and confounded together who seek after my soul to destroy it. Let them be turned backward and…
Let them be disappointed and confounded who seek my soul. Let those who desire my ruin be turned back in disgrace.
Let them be turned because of their shame who say, “Aha! Aha!”
Let them be disappointed and turned backward, all those who hate Zion.
When his disciples, James and John, saw this, they said, “Lord, do you want us to command fire to come down from the…
Now, Lord, look at their threats, and grant to your servants to speak your word with all boldness,
while you stretch out your hand to heal; and that signs and wonders may be done through the name of your holy Servant…

translations.web: When therefore he said to them, “I am he,” they went backward, and fell to the ground.
translations.bsb: When Jesus said, “I am He,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
translations.kjv: As soon then as he had said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
translations.asv: When therefore he said unto them, I am he, they went backward, and fell to the ground.
